rule: Each portal replicates its guardian + identity state to an independent Supabase-compatible Postgres. Reads fail over to the mirror whenever the vendor-managed primary is unhealthy. Lovable is last resort only.

selfHealing.cron: every 15 minutes (GitHub Actions + pg_cron + master sweep)
selfHealing.retry: bounded exponential backoff with jitter, 5 attempts, durable next-cycle retry
selfHealing.transition: primary authoritative; mirror eligible only after parity verification
selfHealing.escalation: reported to the master over the signed two-way channel
